title: Dr. Pershing
description: Dr. Pershing worked for the Client. When Din Djarin, The Mandalorian, obtained Grogu, for the Client, Pershing took him for examination. Djarin came back for Grogu, and Pershing insisted he had protected Grogu. After the abduction of Grogu, Djarin found Pershing's shuttle. Pershing gave up information, and Djarin used the shuttle to board Gideon's ship.
